@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The teacher f______ds his students from using their cellphones in class.
= forbids
~詞義 forbid（v.）禁止
~原文 The teacher forbids his students from using their cellphones in class.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The children showed little e______m for the game. They thought it was boring and said they would rather watch TV.
= enthusiasm
~詞義 enthusiasm（n.）熱忱
~原文 The children showed little enthusiasm for the game. They thought it was boring and said they would rather watch TV.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Rosa is a c______e person who prefers traditional values, so she often worries about the rapid changes in modern society.
= conservative
~詞義 conservative（adj.）保守的
~原文 Rosa is a conservative person who prefers traditional values, so she often worries about the rapid changes in modern society.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Some people think it is d______g to eat worms, but others find them delicious.
= disgusting
~詞義 disgusting（adj.）令人噁心的
~原文 Some people think it is disgusting to eat worms, but others find them delicious.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Jacky is a t______e kid; his mother has had to go to his school many times because of the problems he has caused.
= troublesome
~詞義 troublesome（adj.）麻煩的;令人煩惱的
~原文 Jacky is a troublesome kid; his mother has had to go to his school many times because of the problems he has caused.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Apart from wealth in agriculture, this area is also very rich in ______ such as gold and iron.
A: minerals
B: quarrels
C: plumbers
D: statistics
= A
~詞義 mineral（n.）礦物
~原文 Apart from wealth in agriculture, this area is also very rich in minerals such as gold and iron.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Please send my ______ to your husband and children. I hope your family has a great New Year!
A: homelands
B: workouts
C: statistics
D: greetings
= D
~詞義 greeting（n.）問候
~原文 Please send my greetings to your husband and children. I hope your family has a great New Year!

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The robber finally turned himself in at the police station because his guilty ______ had been keeping him awake at night.
A: enlargement
B: refusal
C: conscience
D: gratitude
= C
~詞義 conscience（n.）良知
~原文 The robber finally turned himself in at the police station because his guilty conscience had been keeping him awake at night.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Jackson's father gives him a monthly ______ of ten thousand dollars. No wonder he can buy so many expensive clothes.
A: allowance
B: recovery
C: welfare
D: homeland
= A
~詞義 allowance（n.）零用錢
~原文 Jackson's father gives him a monthly allowance of ten thousand dollars. No wonder he can buy so many expensive clothes.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The police had the photos ______ in order to identify the thief.
A: winked
B: blended
C: enlarged
D: reflected
= C
~詞義 enlarge（v.）放大
~原文 The police had the photos enlarged in order to identify the thief.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: reflections
B: microscope
C: amateur
D: dispute
E: stabbed
F: keen

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Lily decided to join a(n) ______ tennis league to improve her skills and see if there was any chance of becoming a professional in the future.
= C
~詞義 amateur（adj.）業餘的
~原文 Lily decided to join a(n) amateur tennis league to improve her skills and see if there was any chance of becoming a professional in the future.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Before we could view the cells under a(n) ______, the biology teacher gave us some instructions on how to use it.
= B
~詞義 microscope（n.）顯微鏡
~原文 Before we could view the cells under a(n) microscope, the biology teacher gave us some instructions on how to use it.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Judy's contribution to the project was beyond ______; the final success depended on her leadership.
= D
~詞義 dispute（n.）無庸置疑的(beyond dispute)
~原文 Judy's contribution to the project was beyond dispute; the final success depended on her leadership.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: It is said that dogs cannot recognize their own ______ in the mirror.
= A
~詞義 reflection（n.）倒影
~原文 It is said that dogs cannot recognize their own reflections in the mirror.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The victim was ______ in the chest and lost a large amount of blood.
= E
~詞義 stab（v.）刺
~原文 The victim was stabbed in the chest and lost a large amount of blood.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: alcohol
B: cunning
C: ground
D: tremendous
E: withdraw
F: spare

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Lisa's mom likes her boyfriend a lot because he doesn't drink ______ or smoke.
= A
~詞義 alcohol（n.）酒
~原文 Lisa's mom likes her boyfriend a lot because he doesn't drink alcohol or smoke.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The chef ______ the spices into a fine powder, which gave the soup a stronger flavor.
= C
~詞義 grind（v.）磨碎
~原文 The chef ground the spices into a fine powder, which gave the soup a stronger flavor.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Janet praised her husband for the ______ support he had given her while she was starting her business.
= D
~詞義 tremendous（adj.）巨大的
~原文 Janet praised her husband for the tremendous support he had given her while she was starting her business.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: My favorite activity during my ______ time is reading novels.
= F
~詞義 spare（adj.）空閒的
~原文 My favorite activity during my spare time is reading novels.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: I am going to ______ some money from the ATM because I need to pay my rent.
= E
~詞義 withdraw（v.）提取
~原文 I am going to withdraw some money from the ATM because I need to pay my rent.
